$comment: The six guarded-path arms of flow/scripts/detect-context.sh's decide() as data — three blocks, three warns. Every `arms[].reason` is copied verbatim from the bash oracle, including its own `(current: $state)` suffix where it has one; the engine substitutes the literal token `{state}` with the actually-queried state. `match` entries may be literal paths or globs (`*`/`?`, matching any run of / any one character INCLUDING `/`, same as bash's own case-pattern matching) — every entry additionally matches on any path-boundary suffix of the queried path (an absolute path, a `../`-prefixed one, or one nested under an extra directory), reproducing the oracle's own `PATTERN|*/PATTERN` idiom without needing it spelled out here. `arms` is read top to bottom; the first arm whose `states` admits the queried state wins, `states: "*"` being the else/catch-all. Never edit this file in an install; it is replaced on upgrade — override from a project's own policy layer instead.
